causes.label: wind_output
causes.quote: Wind output was low due to calm conditions in South Australia. During the evening of high prices, average 30-minute wind generation in the region was 41 MW. During the same evening period across the week prior, the average wind generation was around 420 MW.

causes.label: network_outage
causes.quote: Planned network outages contributed to all high prices across the quarter.

causes.label: interconnector_limit
causes.quote: A planned outage of one South East to Tailem Bend line limited flows into South Australia on the Heywood interconnector to between 80 MW and 154 MW, compared to its nominal capacity of 600 MW. In addition, the Murraylink interconnector was on a planned outage. The combined outages on the two interconnectors limited South Australia's ability to import low-priced capacity by around 650 MW, while only up to 71 MW of high-priced capacity was needed to meet demand in the energy market.

causes.label: rebids
causes.quote: Rebidding for technical and commercial reasons contributed to the high prices (Appendix A).
